title: Scp-023 The Black Dog
style: cinematic found-footage horror photograph, over-the-shoulder composition, shallow depth of field, one cold light source, heavy film grain, photorealistic, absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no timestamps, no watermarks, vertical composition

credit.author: Pig_catapult
credit.line: Based on SCP-023 by Pig_catapult - scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-023 - CC BY-SA 3.0

post_caption: One look, and someone you love dies in exactly a year. Would you meet its eyes?

Hero.look: Short brown hair, dark Foundation jacket, seen only from behind.

scenes.image_prompt: Over-the-shoulder photograph, back of {Hero} out of focus low in frame, long dark corridor crossroads far ahead, tiny shaggy black dog with orange-red glowing eyes, large empty black space above, one dim red light. {style}

lines.text: Day one. A secret organization that locks away things that should not exist took in a black dog with burning orange eyes.

scenes.label: DAY 2
scenes.image_prompt: Photograph over the shoulder of {Hero}, out of focus; dark corridor floor with scorched ash footprints and a faint orange-red glow under a closed door, no creature visible, one red emergency light. {style}

lines.text: Day two. Meet its eyes, and you or someone in your family dies exactly one year after you look away.

scenes.label: DAY 3
scenes.image_prompt: Over the shoulder of {Hero}, out of focus, a steel autopsy table under one harsh lamp, a sheet-covered body, grey ash spilling from the sheet's edge, no creature visible. {style}

lines.text: Day three. Its victims look untouched, but the autopsies found every organ replaced with packed ash.

scenes.label: DAY 4
scenes.image_prompt: Over the shoulder of {Hero}, out of focus, a hand reaching toward a door handle at a corridor crossroads, three painted false doors, one real door, camera above, one dim light, creature absent. {style}

lines.text: Day four. So it sits in a crossroads of corridors, three false doors, one real, or it walks through walls.

scenes.label: DAY 5
scenes.image_prompt: Over the shoulder of {Hero}, out of focus, far down a dark corridor a huge shaggy black dog with burning orange-red eyes half hidden behind a doorframe, prominent teeth, one red light. {style}

lines.text: Day five. Rubber covers its eyes, changed one at a time after dark; whoever looks pays within a year.

scenes.label: DAY 6
scenes.image_prompt: Over the shoulder of {Hero} facing a dim monitor, on screen a tiny distant shaggy black dog half hidden in darkness, two orange-red glowing eyes, only the screen's glow lighting the room. {style}

lines.text: Day six. Tired, I checked the camera feed on a monitor, the one thing banned after the last incident.

scenes.label: DAY 7
scenes.image_prompt: Over the shoulder of {Hero}, frozen, a huge shaggy black dog with burning orange-red eyes and prominent teeth standing mostly in darkness in a doorway ahead, one red light behind. {style}

lines.text: Day seven. Short entry, because it already happened: I met its eyes, and the year has started.

scenes.label: NEXT ENTRY
scenes.image_prompt: Out of focus, huge shaggy black canine with burning orange-red eyes and prominent teeth very close behind the shoulder of {Hero}, not touching, mostly in darkness, lit by one red light. {style}

lines.text: I let the rubber fade, and I wanted you to look. Now someone you love is counted.

archivist_note: TAPE 09  -  The dust was wiped from one case. Only that one.
